notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR disagrees with itself: build field 1936, description 1935. No source read gives staffing, closure, fate or current public access, so the story says so. The NHLR links an article, Exploring the Forgotten Fire Towers of Alabama (rootsrated.com), which returned no text from fetch_text; it was not read. A search snippet gives elevation 178 ft (584 m) from aboutus.com, against the NHLR's 563 ft (172 m), which matches the record's 171.6 m; not verified. Access status should be checked with the Talladega National Forest before any visit advice is published.
